entries.title: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
entries.summary: The release of GPT-6 Astra marks the emergence of a new paradigm in robotics: agentic robotics. Within weeks, frontier models with agentic harnesses matched or exceeded task-specific policies on many embodied benchmarks.
entries.why: 101 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.AI

entries.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
entries.summary: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning.
entries.why: 70 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.AI

entries.title: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
entries.summary: World-model video encoders such as V-JEPA learn how scenes change (direction, speed, order, state) from video alone. To answer questions, they are joined to a language model trained on captions and question-answer pairs.
entries.why: 20 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.CV

entries.title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
entries.summary: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), an increasing number of users are turning to LLM-powered agents for conversational shopping in e-commerce.
entries.why: 15 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.AI

entries.title: Aligning AI Teams
entries.summary: Previous work has shown that alignment training on individual LLM agents can fail to transfer to multi-agent settings. We investigate the underlying mechanisms for this failure, and explore interventions to preserve alignment transfer to multi-agent LLM teams.
entries.why: 10 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.AI

entries.title: AI Reviews Are Biased Towards the Appendix
entries.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by reviewers to highlight weaknesses during the reviewing process, and their outputs often shape the reviews that humans submit.
entries.why: 9 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.CL

entries.title: DySENSE: Dynamic Spatiotemporal ENergy Synthesis and Emulation with Satellite Imagery
entries.summary: Cities account for over two-thirds of the world's energy and more than 70% of global carbon dioxide emissions. City energy is essential for achieving the 2050 net-zero target and the UN's Sustainable Development Goals 7 and 11.
entries.why: 9 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.CV
